### 22.10.2026 — #87 P32 canonical generator protection gate
- [x] [PR #203](https://github.com/Deserag/slavic-myths/pull/203) source and [PR #204](https://github.com/Deserag/slavic-myths/pull/204) final docs merged; main `a0d0f5e97ea4dbb0d30f5a5f41f78eb8d3e9e972`.
- [x] Canonical `weapons87_flails.py --apply` replay twice in throwaway sandbox, **zero mutations of actual source**. All 68 weapon item IDs, 16 protected crossbows/Kalin/Victor/Pool assets, double replay idempotent. 30 file-byte diffs (12 model JSON + 18 flail PNG) but **0 JSON-structure or RGBA pixel differences**, so no actual art rollback. SHA differences documented instead of rewriting historical frozen manifests.
- [x] Java21 `clean build`, 294 JAR asset checks and source generator assertions PASS [CI #39776454779](https://github.com/Deserag/slavic-myths/actions/runs/39776454779); `slavicmyths-1.9.7.56.jar` SHA256 `d920d52874db3d9d1d811756ff10177f0c9b94aec3db7c9edcf73eb34f86790f`. Full before/after generator report in Actions artifact and [PACKAGE-32.md](https://github.com/Deserag/slavic-myths/blob/main/docs/implementation/weapons87/PACKAGE-32.md).
- [ ] Historical other standalone entrypoints and accepted owner-gameplay 1P/3P not all tested; old 109 audit SHA and51 flail manifest SHA remain archive differences. **Issue OPEN**, runtime Minecraft/PolyMC NOT_RUN, not owner-accepted.

comments.body: P46 targeted regression repair в одной рабочей ветке, source commit [`549e39bf`](https://github.com/Deserag/slavic-myths/commit/549e39bfe7fd5078f594a65692401cb9f9f0fc2d), draft PR #216. `verify_weapons87_crossbows.py` и `weapons87_owner_qa.py` опирались на pre-P42 frozen records и ошибочно отвергали принятую source P42 аддитивную геометрию арбалетов: +5 `serpent_crossbow`, +3 `three_breath_crossbow` во всех 12 states. Не удалили baseline/не отключили tests: теперь строгий old-elements + exact approved `weapons87_p42_models.ADDITIONS[id]`, прежние TP pivot/metadata/source checks сохранены. Это исправление QA-цепочки, **не** исправление самой игровой геометрии, не runtime acceptance. CI для нового commit будет проверен отдельно, source/Java21/JAR P45 уже PASS [#39813871455](https://github.com/Deserag/slavic-myths/actions/runs/39813871455). Никаких изменений `main`, моделей/баланса, Issues OPEN/IN_PROGRESS.
